title: Minimax RMST Estimation under Joint Vanishing of Treatment and Censoring Probabilities
banked_reason: D0.5.G below novelty floor: subfield < field; paper_score_ceiling 7.3 < 7.4, salvageable=false, while both substantive panels pass.
gap_reasons: The note proves a matched absolute-error and honest expected-length frontier only for a fixed uniform covariate law and fixed known treatment and censoring mechanisms satisfying a prescribed product envelope; it does not deliver an observational procedure when those mechanisms or exponents must be estimated.

The leading-journal score is constrained by the stylized one-dimensional known-mechanism benchmark, the absence of numerical evidence about the cutoff interval's finite-sample behavior, and related-work comparisons that do not map the closest published theorem hypotheses and rates against this class in detail.
Not salvageable within scope — bank downgraded, or re-anchor the proposal (rewind D-1.2).
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived a matched known-mechanism RMST minimax and honest-length frontier, the full observed-data lower construction, and the alpha=3 endpoint elbow. Formalization reached F2.5, where a lower-direction completion ambiguity was repaired in the source and independently revalidated by both substantive panels; the subsequent cold general review graded the unchanged package subfield, below the field floor. A new field-tier attempt would need a materially broader result, such as a proved unknown-mechanism adaptation, rather than another identical review.
tldr: For every censor-endpoint exponent \(\alpha>0\), the sharp full-population RMST frontier is universal over fixed known treatment and censoring mechanisms satisfying \(\underline g x^\gamma(x^\delta+u^\alpha)\leq e_1(x)G_1(1-u\mid x)\leq\overline g x^\gamma(x^\delta+u^\alpha)\), a control-propensity floor, and the control censoring floor. Endpoint depletion is second-moment harmless for \(0<\alpha<3\); at \(\alpha=3\) it contributes only an integrable logarithm. Hence \(0<\alpha\leq3\) is always root-\(n\), and the root-\(n\), \(\sqrt{\log n/n}\), and irregular power-law transition begins only on the radial branch \(\alpha>3\). A deterministic cutoff and finite-sample bias-aware interval attain the frontier, complete censored-data alternatives match both minimax risk and honest expected length, and the same elbow appears in remaining-time information. Pointwise efficiency is confined to the fixed-covariate-law, fixed-\(e\), fixed-\(G\) event-hazard experiment. Lower bounds transfer to broader experiments containing this hazard subclass; upper bounds, coverage, and efficiency variance do not transfer without mechanism estimation and diagnostics.
gap: Published RMST weighting work addresses extreme propensity scores largely through overlap weighting or regular asymptotics, and published small-denominator IPW theory does not incorporate the complete right-censored likelihood or the remaining-time geometry of RMST. No inspected result gives matched full-population risk and honest expected-length orders at a simultaneous treatment-censoring corner.
fill: The project derives the joint score-tail profile, an explicit nuisance-free cutoff estimator and finite-sample honest interval, a complete-likelihood multiscale converse, the remaining-time efficiency boundary, and pointwise efficient attainment for arbitrary measurable interior hazards.
